responsibility: Implements terminal colorization and terminal-URL policy for diagnostics output. This file owns parsing of GCC_COLORS overrides into named style entries, default SGR mappings for diagnostic elements such as errors, warnings, ranges, fix-its, and diffs, environment- and terminal-based decisions for --color and URL auto-enablement, and the runtime helpers used by printers and sinks to start and stop colorized regions or choose URL escape formats.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable side of the color pair: it owns the default style table, GCC_COLORS parsing, terminal capability checks, Windows/TTY handling, and URL auto-enable decisions, plus the color selftests. By contrast, color.h is just the small API surface used by callers.
